mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 3.0% indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate below 5.0% for three months signals a tight labor market that increases consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE has been below 5.0% for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) above 2000 and consumer credit (RSAFS) above 350000 indicates robust household demand, which fuels economic expansion and positive equity returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of HOUST>2000 and RSAFS>350000 fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO) below 120 signals manufacturing weakness that typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days during early recession phases.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO is below 120 during early recession.

mechanism_narrative: An expanding labor market, indicated by rising PAYEMS, supports economic growth and corporate profits, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS is increasing.

mechanism_narrative: When CPIAUCSL exceeds 195.0, it reflects accelerating inflation that triggers monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 195.0.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 120 coupled with rising unemployment (UNRATE) above 4.5% indicates economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of INDPRO<120 and UNRATE>4.5% fails to produce negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Residential housing starts (HOUST) above 2050 signal strong consumer confidence and economic momentum, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST exceeds 2050.
